title: Slip build request
description: The body a client sends with POST. Two fields, and the closed object is the point: in Mode A an endpoint learns one address the client chose and the network it is on, and nothing else about the person. Normative for version 1.

network.description: Named rather than numeric: CIP-30's network id cannot separate preprod from preview.

paymentAddress.description: Bech32 payment address per CIP-19. A reward address is not one, and neither is anything else the wallet can produce.
